title: Jesus Spoke from the Cradle
arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
translation: “Peace be on me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I am raised alive.”

sunni.label: Sunni emphasis
sunni.body: Sunni tafsir hears God's protection - safety granted at life's three hardest thresholds: birth, death, and resurrection. The infant's speech clears his mother's name and proclaims his prophethood.

shia.label: Shia emphasis
shia.body: Shia tafsir hears the same peace - inner security carried through those three passages. Spoken first as the servant of God, the child names servanthood the highest human station.

voiceover.hook: In the Quran, Jesus speaks as a newborn - his very first words, from the cradle.
voiceover.question: Christian or Muslim, what does this verse stir in you

cta_text: Christian or Muslim - what does this verse stir in you?
